strongest_ideas: Joint corner+primitive shortest-cycle DP per interface with the corner CNN as raw log-odds unaries — no threshold, no NMS, no collapse window; this is the principled fix for the 0.73 F1 ceiling and is graftable WITHOUT the rest of PRISM (it slots where paper_corner_positions + _iterated_removal + fit_segment_midpoints meet, reusing the existing interval machinery as the feasibility oracle)
Subpixel evidence tube as the ONE fidelity gate, with the crack polyline always feasible — the cleanest structural proof that a staircase fallback can never be needed

Regularity-as-hypothesis + exact one-shot selection (order-independent) replacing the sequential snapshot-and-revert chain — even a greedy selector over the same hypothesis schema would beat today's order-dependent budget-eating
Prototype pooling: fit one shared curve chain against all instances' evidence simultaneously (n glyphs = sqrt(n) noise reduction) — the best text-quality idea in the pool
fatal_flaws: The global interval-constrained SQP with hard G2 equalities across mixed line/arc/clothoid/ellipse chains is a standalone research project; the design itself admits it 'will rattle' near degenerate configurations, and a rattling SQP is the least debuggable failure mode imaginable for this team
Effort estimates (37 days total for 8 components including the SQP at 7 days) are 3-5x optimistic; the certified gates go dark for months during the stage C/D/E swaps with no shippable intermediate

It replaces essentially everything after segmentation at once — the 4225-line calibrated pipeline becomes scaffolding for a new solver stack (CP-SAT + SQP + lazy-cut loop); when output is wrong, the debugging surface is an active-set trace, not a function you can step through

The CP-SAT/SQP lazy-feasibility interplay and the outer relabel-and-rebuild alternation are two nested fixpoint loops on top of each other; 'monotone and terminating' on paper, but the interaction bugs will consume the schedule

strongest_ideas: Linear-RGB coverage unmixing + erf-ESF calibration → a DETERMINISTIC subpixel evidence field with per-probe sigma, no training required; feeding this into the existing DP (interval center moved to the probe, width shrunk where confident, unchanged where not) is the single highest leverage-per-day graft available — it attacks wobble, tiny-circle roundness, and staircase collapse at the root cause (fitting to quantized crack midpoints)
One acceptance law (DeltaL_perc <= lambda_mdl * DeltaMDL + floor) replacing the zoo of per-regularizer thresholds — a maintenance win the tech lead should covet even in a heuristic pipeline

Template fitting directly to the anti-aliased coverage field (analytic pixel coverage vs observed alpha) for small loops — over-determined 4:1 at 6px; strictly better than any mask-IoU tournament for tiny shapes
Fallback ladder terminating in a direct spline fit — the worst output becomes a smooth raster-faithful curve by construction
Audit metrics that run identically on vectorizer.ai's SVGs — turns 'beat VAI' from an assertion into a measurement
fatal_flaws: diffvg on Windows is a known build hazard (custom CUDA extension); the in-house fallback is honest but the '+4 days' estimate is fantasy — this is the load-bearing polish stage sitting on the shakiest dependency

The court's runtime is unbounded in principle: edit-queue-to-fixpoint with render escalation on a 500-region image needs the edit-budget cap they only mention as a mitigation; interactive latency is a hope, not a design property
Gradient-descent polish (Adam, GPU) sits in tension with the team's determinism requirement — bitwise reproducibility across driver versions is not something Adam-on-CUDA gives you for free
Re-basing the entire certification harness from region-mask IoU to rendered output is a disruptive prerequisite buried in the risks list; until it's done, every stage gate is ambiguous

strongest_ideas: Single-owner boundaries + 0.75px under-apron: the cheapest structural seam kill in the pool — Stage 1 of its plan (ownership + apron in paper-regions mode, no amodal completion yet) is graftable in days and makes seams unrepresentable without any z-order inference

Glyphs as a top z-layer with their own fitting profile — matches the VAI forensic finding, localizes the text-safe/tiny-safe/collapse-window changes to the one layer where they matter, and lets underlying shapes complete smoothly beneath letters

Regularizers on COMPLETE outlines: arbitrary-axis mirror and Procrustes repeat unification become cheap once shapes are whole — the observation that completeness is what makes the full symmetry group affordable is correct and transferable
Per-shape fallback ladder: a failed fit costs one shape, not the image — the right blast-radius discipline
fatal_flaws: Z-order inference is the load-bearing new subsystem and flat design is exactly the domain where its cues (T-junctions, continuation) are weakest; the 'abut = zero-hidden-area occlusion' reduction papers over the fact that ownership choices will flip between near-identical inputs and every flip changes corner placement — a determinism/stability tarpit the design waves at with tie-break-by-index

Amodal completion creates a NEW artifact class this pipeline has never had (false merges, completed shapes peeking through, wrong bridges under occluders); the verifier catches them, but frequent rejection pushes shapes down the ladder and the debugging loop for 'why did these two regions fuse' is slow and adversarial

Staircases are not actually abolished: the ladder's last rung is region-native fitting, which still exits through _finish_loop's _pixel_faithful_curves path — the design fixes the text/tiny CAUSES but keeps the mechanism
Interlocking/cyclic occlusion handling (ring splitting) is acknowledged as 'genuinely fiddly to get pixel-right' — that is where the schedule goes to die

strongest_ideas: Stage A (week 1, zero ML): universal crack graph, backstop ladder, alpha fix, color re-estimation, elliptic arc, clothoid Gauss-Newton, text/tiny-safe auto-routing — this is independently valuable and nearly identical to the pragmatist plan's core, proving the two designs share a spine

The safety contract done right: tanh-bounded ±0.5px architectural clamp on SEF offsets + confidence gate (w<=0.7 → exactly today's behavior) + Hausdorff measured against RAW cracks — worst case is provably the current output; this is the correct template for ANY ML graft into this pipeline
Posterior term gamma*log((1-p)/p) in the Algorithm-2 removal energy — finally lets detector confidence and geometric parsimony argue in one energy (closes gap 11 properly, not with a margin hack)
Analytic GT byproducts: svg_corner_gt.py already walks paths, so tangent/curvature/primitive-class labels are FREE — the cheapest training-data insight in the pool
Teacher-student regularity proposals where the teacher is an exact offline searcher — labels contain no perceptual wishfulness, and the verifier means the student can only add recall
fatal_flaws: Five models = five data generators, five training loops, five calibration procedures, five domain-gap monitors — on one GPU box with a small team the 49-day estimate is realistically 100+; the schedule is dominated by training iteration, which is unplannable

Model failures are silent quality regressions visible only in aggregate metrics; when SEF is confidently wrong on a JPEG texture class, root-causing it is model archaeology, not a stack trace — a real step down in debuggability from the current all-geometric pipeline

BT event-F1 >= 0.85 is a target, not a mechanism — if the transformer plateaus at 0.78 the whole text story shrinks to the Stage-A heuristics; the plan has no fallback for perception-model underperformance other than 'today's behavior'
The RPN's exact offline teacher (RANSAC correspondence search over iconify + 365 logos) is a multi-week build hiding inside one line item, needed before the student can even start

strongest_ideas: benchmark_vai.py FIRST (staircase rate, wobble, roundness, curvature-fairness, seam pixels, measured against frozen VAI references) — the only design that fixes the actual process failure: today an aesthetic regression passes every gate; every other design needs this harness too and none prioritizes it at day 1.5

Every line number verified against the real file — the strikes land in known functions with known revert paths; this is the only plan where 'keep the gates green while shipping' is a property of the plan rather than a promise

Text-safe default flip: the codebase's own docstring at _finish_loop:2702 documents the 29-86 staircase-line failure and the fix already exists behind a flag — hours of work for one of the largest single perceptual wins available

Worst-artifact-salience thesis: eliminating the bottom of our distribution (staircases, seams) buys more human preference than raising the top — the correct prioritization theory for beating a mature competitor
Scale-aware collapse window min(16*spacing, 0.35*extent, 3px) and the kappa*(p-0.5) removal margin — small, calibratable, revertible corner fixes
fatal_flaws: No subpixel evidence anywhere: it keeps fitting to quantized crack midpoints, so the root cause of wobble and tiny-circle squareness survives all nine strikes — the tiny-icon and smooth-silhouette ceilings stay below what render-loss/ml-first reach, and those are two of the three declared battlegrounds

The 0.25px paint-order stroke bleed is a patch, not a structural fix — it fattens shapes, breaks under future transparency, complicates the IoU certification it must itself defend, and the seam problem regresses the moment someone changes emission

Corner ceiling raised only to ~0.78 target with the same threshold→NMS→collapse architecture; the design has no answer if the confidence-margin tweak plateaus — the joint-DP fix exists only in competing designs

'After the floor is fixed, our ceiling is higher than VAI's' is the plan's weakest claim: G2 fairing at joins + a wider symmetry group may still lose the ceiling comparison on large smooth silhouettes and 16px icons, exactly where the harness it builds will prove it

synthesis_advice: Spine: PUNCHLIST, in its own order — Stage 0 harness (benchmark_vai.py) is non-negotiable and must land before anything else from ANY design, because it is the only instrument that can gate the grafts. Then Stages 1-3 (backstop ladder, text-safe flip, always-on region graph, text/tiny path, alpha/color) largely as written — note ml-first's Stage A independently converged on the same list, which is strong evidence it is the right week-one core. Two modifications to the spine: (1) replace the 0.25px stroke-bleed seam hack with scene-layers' Stage-1 graft — single-owner interfaces plus a 0.75px under-apron on the losing shape in write_svgs; it is barely more work, structurally sound rather than cosmetic, and doesn't fatten topmost regions; (2) adopt scene-layers' glyph-top-layer z-order for the font_match substitution path (pragmatist already emits substituted runs top-z; make it a real layer policy). Graft 1 (highest leverage per day, do right after Stage 3): render-loss's DETERMINISTIC evidence extractor — linear-RGB coverage unmixing + erf-ESF calibration producing per-crack subpixel offsets and confidence — wired into fit_segment_midpoints exactly under ml-first's safety contract (move interval center to the probe, shrink width only where confidence is high, keep ±0.5px elsewhere, Hausdorff still measured against raw cracks). This closes the pragmatist's biggest ceiling gap (wobble, tiny roundness) with zero training, zero new dependencies, and graceful degradation to today's behavior; only if it measurably fails on JPEG should SEF-Net be considered. Graft 2: render-loss/scene-layers' coverage-field template fitting (analytic pixel coverage vs observed alpha, Adam or Gauss-Newton over 3-7 params) replacing the pragmatist's 4x-mask-IoU tiny tournament — same slot in fit_loop_paper, strictly better evidence at ≤24px. Graft 3 (only after the harness shows the corner ceiling binding, i.e. if the kappa*(p-0.5) margin + scale-aware collapse plateaus below ~0.80 F1): global-energy's joint corner+primitive DP as a scoped replacement for threshold→NMS→collapse→Algorithm-2 on a per-loop basis, reusing the existing interval machinery as the feasibility oracle and the Platt-calibrated CNN as unaries — take the Cornucopia-style DP alone, NOT the ILP/SQP superstructure. Defer indefinitely: global SQP with hard G2 (use pragmatist's bounded per-join fairing with interval-recheck revert instead), diffvg polish, z-order inference/amodal completion beyond the ownership+apron slice, and all five ARGUS models except as later, individually-gated upgrades. Sequencing rule throughout: nothing lands without a benchmark_vai.py delta and green certified-logo floors, and every graft must inherit the confidence-gated 'worst case = today's output' contract.
